name: TY(C3)-parity-equivariantization
source_construction: (TY(C3,chi,+1/sqrt(3)) Deligne Vec(C2))^C2, with chi(a,b)=exp(2*pi*i*a*b/3) and F(X,e)=(I(X),e+|X|); canonical tensorators and identity square coherence.
source_reference: Tambara--Yamagami, J. Algebra 209 (1998), 692-707; Gelaki--Naidu--Nikshych, Centers of graded fusion categories, Section 4A and Proposition 4.8; explicit coherent actions in papers/ty_equivariant_models.md.

name: TY(C3)-twisted-C4-equivariantization
source_construction: The C2 equivariantization of the diagonal subcategory of TY(C3,chi,+1/sqrt(3)) Deligne Vec(C4,omega1); simultaneous inversion, explicit scalar tensorator U, and identity square coherence. All phases, cocycle equations and equivariant Hom invariants are replayed in software/ty_equivariant_models.py.
source_reference: Tambara--Yamagami, J. Algebra 209 (1998), 692-707; Gelaki--Naidu--Nikshych, Centers of graded fusion categories, Section 4A and Proposition 4.8; explicit coherent actions in papers/ty_equivariant_models.md.

name: Vec(Q8)^S3
source_construction: The unitary equivariantization Vec(Q8)^S3 for the strict action e_a -> sign(p)*e_p(a) on the three quaternion axes. Fixed central grades carry the three ordinary S3 irreducibles; the six noncentral grades form one free orbit.
source_reference: Explicit quaternion group and signed-axis S3 action; orbit/stabilizer equivariantization theory of Burciu--Natale, Fusion rules of equivariantizations of fusion categories. Full construction and proof in the manuscript.

name: C(Q8rtimesS3,Chern,S3,1)
source_construction: The unitary group-theoretical category C(Q8 semidirect S3, Omega, S3, 1), where [Omega]=c2(V)-infl c2(R), V(q,p)=qR(p), and R implements the signed-axis quaternion action. The global characteristic class has a representative trivial on S3; its explicit restriction to C2 times S3 determines all fusion rules.
source_reference: Explicit characteristic-class construction in papers/r7_4_2019_chern_proof.md; Gelaki--Naidu, Some properties of group-theoretical categories, Section 3 and Theorem 5.1; Atiyah, Characters and cohomology of finite groups, appendix.

name: Reflection Morita dual of the inversion extension of NG(C4²,16) diagonal orbifold
source_construction: Start with Yu-Zhang NG(C4×C4,16), centrally de-equivariantize by diagonal C4, descend the untwisted regular-group self-Morita equivalence to a coherent inversion C2 action, take the crossed product, and dualize its reflection algebra 1+s.
source_reference: R35_INVERSION_CONSTRUCTION.md; Yu-Zhang Proposition3.1; Izumi Theorems11.3,12.5,13.4 and Corollary13.5; Shimizu Theorem3.4; Ng-Schauenburg Theorem9.2.

name: Reflection Morita dual of the inversion extension of NG(C16,16) orbifold
source_construction: Start with Budinski NG(C16,16), centrally de-equivariantize by 4C16, descend the regular-C16 self-Morita equivalence to a coherent inversion C2 action, take the crossed product, and dualize its reflection algebra 1+s.
source_reference: R2665_INVERSION_CONSTRUCTION.md; Budinski, Theorem 3.1.1 and Section 3.3.2; Izumi, Theorems 11.3, 12.5, 13.4 and Corollary 13.5; Grossman-Jordan-Snyder, Lemma 4.7 and Remark 4.8; Liu-Ng, Proposition 5.3.
